items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I never could know who that guy was either. I don't remember this little fella.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's a fella. I never could know who that guy was either. I don't remember this little fella.

Supposed to be one fella, Coochie Martin, that played with the Peerless Band at one period. He was a brother, there was another Henry Martin who played drums too. Their mother took care of a school up there on Perdido Street. Remember in Louis Armstrong's neighborhood up there right there? Yeah, yeah, yeah.
I remember the school you're speaking about.
